name: Population of BARMM barangays, 2024, by town

source.label: PSA, 2024 Census of Population (POPCEN), by barangay, as printed in the PSGC

note: PSA's 2024 census count for 2174 of the directory's 2185 barangays. The rest are spelled or filed under another town in the newer PSGC, or (three in Marawi) not in it.
